title: Aspose CLI error envelope
description: The single error shape of the CLI, written to stderr when a command fails. Error codes are stable identifiers designed for agent self-correction.

code.description: SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE error code for the current CLI surface, e.g. FILE_NOT_FOUND.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong, including valid alternatives where applicable.

hint.description: Recommended next action for the caller.

docs.description: Topic name for `aspose-cli docs <topic>` with background details.
